tagline: Simplify healthcare payments through modern cloud-based AI-powered software
hero_kpi_rationale: Waystar's AI-powered platform, Waystar AltitudeAI, is central to its value proposition, automating complex workflows and driving continuous improvement through real-time data from 7.5B+ transactions. This positions AI adoption as the key growth driver across all solutions.

kpis.name: Percentage of contracts including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of deployed solutions using AI to automate healthcare payments.
kpis.description: Waystar integrates AI into all its solutions, notably through AltitudeAI, leveraging generative and agentic models to automate workflows.
kpis.signal: Entire platform powered by proprietary AI (AltitudeAI).

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company through its software and services.
kpis.description: Revenue of 1,099.3 million USD in 2025, up 16.5% from 943.5 million USD in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong double-digit growth, driven by increasing adoption and customer expansion.

kpis.name: Net Revenue Retention rate
kpis.explanation: Measures customer loyalty and incremental spending over time.
kpis.description: Net Revenue Retention rate of 112.0% on 12-month basis at end of 2025, indicating existing customers spend 12% more on average.
kpis.signal: Excellent NRR exceeding 110%, indicating strong customer loyalty and sustained organic growth.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization and non-recurring adjustments.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA of 462.1 million USD in 2025, versus 383.5 million USD in 2024.
kpis.signal: Profitability growing sharply, with 20.5% increase year-over-year.

kpis.name: Gross claims volume
kpis.explanation: Total amount of medical claims processed by the platform.
kpis.description: In 2025, Waystar processed over 2.4 trillion USD in claims, covering approximately 60% of US patients.
kpis.signal: Massive platform processing 2.4 trillion USD in claims covering 60% of American patients.

kpis.name: Annual transactions
kpis.explanation: Number of payments or requests processed per year.
kpis.description: In 2025, Waystar facilitated over 7.5 billion healthcare payment transactions.
kpis.signal: Large-scale platform with 7.5 billion annual transactions proving massive adoption.

kpis.name: Number of clients
kpis.explanation: Total number of customer organizations using the platform.
kpis.description: Waystar has over 30,000 clients, representing over one million healthcare professionals, including 16 of the top 20 US hospitals by US News & World Report ranking.
kpis.signal: Over 30,000 clients, including 16 of the top 20 US hospitals (US News & World Report).

kpis.name: Clients generating over 100k USD annually
kpis.explanation: Number of clients generating over 100,000 USD in annual revenue on a 12-month basis.
kpis.description: Waystar has 1,391 clients generating over 100,000 USD on a 12-month basis at end of 2025.
kpis.signal: Stable base of high-value clients generating 100k+ USD annually, signaling retention and growth.

kpis.name: Percentage of contracts including AI features
kpis.description: Waystar integrates AI into all its solutions, notably through AltitudeAI, leveraging generative and agentic models to automate workflows.
kpis.signal: Entire platform powered by proprietary AI (AltitudeAI).

kpis.name: Net Revenue Retention rate
kpis.description: Net Revenue Retention rate of 112.0% on 12-month basis at end of 2025, indicating existing customers spend 12% more on average.
kpis.signal: Excellent NRR exceeding 110%, indicating strong customer loyalty and sustained organic growth.

kpis.name: Gross claims volume
kpis.description: In 2025, Waystar processed over 2.4 trillion USD in claims, covering approximately 60% of US patients and one-third of hospital discharges.
kpis.signal: Massive platform processing 2.4 trillion USD in claims covering 60% of American patients.

risks.title: Cybersecurity attack and information systems compromise
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity risk is elevated due to the sensitive nature of healthcare data processed. Waystar has established a cybersecurity program overseen by the Board and CISO with ISO/IEC 27001 certifications. Risk persists despite implemented measures.

risks.title: Competition in healthcare IT sector
risks.score_rationale: Competitive market requiring continuous differentiation. Platform must maintain product leadership and invest in R&D to retain customers and brand reputation.

risks.title: Strict healthcare sector regulation
risks.score_rationale: Company operates within strict healthcare regulatory framework. Regulatory changes may require costly adaptations to solutions and operations.

risks.title: Dependence on cloud technology and infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Cloud platform heavily dependent on technology infrastructure availability and performance. Any incident affecting cloud services may impact customer operations and business continuity.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and performance
risks.score_rationale: Waystar has completed 10 acquisitions since 2018, including Iodine for 1.26B USD in October 2025. Risk relates to successful integration and realization of expected synergies.

ai_positioning.summary: Company WAY has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence, machine learning or similar technologies in the excerpts provided from its 10-K/20-F document.
